label: extension

args.subject: Child seat availability at your London location
args.body:
Hello New Car Rental,

Could you please let me know whether you offer child seats with car rentals at your London location? If so, what types of seats are available, are there any additional charges, and do they need to be reserved in advance?

Thank you,
Emma Johnson

final_text: I emailed **support@newcarrental.co.uk**, the address listed in the customer review, asking whether their London location offers child seats, which types are available, any extra charges, and whether advance booking is required.
